instruction: Blanch, peel and roughly chop the tomatoes.
Cook tomatoes with garlic and ginger until soft; blend smooth and strain.
Simmer the purée with butter, chilli powder, salt and sugar until thick.
Finish with cream and garam masala; cool, label with batch time and chill.
Slice onions; chop tomatoes; crush ginger and garlic.
Fry onions in oil until deep golden.
Add ginger, garlic, spices and salt; cook out.
Add tomatoes; cook until oil separates; cool, label and chill.
Peel ginger and garlic.
Blend with oil to a smooth paste; store airtight, labelled.
Pick and wash mint and coriander.
Blend with chillies, lemon juice and salt; chill.
Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.
Boil, drain and rest covered; hold hot, discard after 8 hours.
Dissolve sugar in 500 ml hot water.
Cool, bottle, label with date; refrigerate.
Juice the lemons and strain.
Mix with sugar syrup; bottle, label, refrigerate.
Combine gin, Campari and vermouth with 200 ml chilled water for dilution.
Bottle in 500 ml bottles, label with batch time; refrigerate.
Combine whisky, syrup and bitters with 135 ml water.
Bottle, label and refrigerate.
Slice lemons; combine all ingredients in a dispenser.
Chill at least 2 hours; discard after 48 hours.
Warm 200 g makhani gravy in a pan.
Add the cooked chicken; simmer until hot through.
Finish with cream and butter; garnish with coriander.
Warm the makhani gravy; add the paneer cubes.
Finish with cream; serve hot.
